setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
k = rng.integers(0, 5, 12000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (5, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (12000, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['group'] = pd.Categorical(['Aries', 'Taurus', 'Gemini', 'Cancer', 'Leo'][v] for v in k)
df.shape

steps.name: open annotate tab and enable automatic clusters
steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-annotate').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); sel.value = 'clusters'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: enable two levels of detail (A8 multi-level)
steps.eval: const cb = document.querySelector('[data-section=labels] input[type=checkbox]'); if (cb && !a.labels.multiLevel) { cb.click(); } else { a.setLabelOptions({ multiLevel: true }); }

steps.name: fine clusters are computed when multi-level is on
steps.report: { hasFineClusters: a.clusterFine !== null, fineK: a.clusterFine?.k, totalLabels: a.labelCount }

steps.name: coarse labels render (pixels present)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i+1] + d[i+2] > 60) n++; window.__levelsPixels = n

steps.name: zoom in by 2 levels: programmatic view change triggers label refresh
steps.eval: const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; const newZoom = (vs.zoom || 0) + 2; a.renderer['viewState'] = { ...vs, zoom: newZoom }; a.renderer['deck'].setProps({ viewState: a.renderer['viewState'] }); a.renderer['viewChangeCallback']?.(newZoom); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500))

steps.name: zoom out: programmatic view change
steps.eval: const vs = a.renderer['viewState']; const newZoom = (vs.zoom || 0) - 4; a.renderer['viewState'] = { ...vs, zoom: newZoom }; a.renderer['deck'].setProps({ viewState: a.renderer['viewState'] }); a.renderer['viewChangeCallback']?.(newZoom); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500))

steps.name: collision priority: coarse labels have higher priority than fine labels
verify collision priorities: coarse >= fine
steps.eval: if (a.clusterFine && a.labelCount > a.clusterCount) { const coarseLabels = a.renderer.labels.slice(0, a.clusterCount); const fineLabels = a.renderer.labels.slice(a.clusterCount); const minCoarse = Math.min(...coarseLabels.map(l => l.priority ?? 0)); const maxFine = Math.max(...fineLabels.map(l => l.priority ?? 0)); window.__priorityOk = minCoarse > maxFine; } else { window.__priorityOk = null; }
steps.report: { coarseCount: a.clusterCount, fineCount: a.clusterFine ? a.clusterFine.k : 0, totalLabels: a.labelCount, priorityOk: window.__priorityOk }
